# AAOS UI mother references

Byte-preserved owner-supplied B10 HTML and VI icon-system board, used by portable source contract tests. Original paths and SHA-256 are in [PROVENANCE.json](PROVENANCE.json).

The B10 mother has the highest layout authority under the current user direction. The HTML is a local demo; sample values, random graph details and localStorage are not Core data. Do not deploy this reference as the production application.
